title: Bacon, chard and courgettes on toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Bacon, courgettes, chard, garlic, bread and ricotta are all plain whole foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including chard and ricotta, is an everyday item at a mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: Only a frying pan and a toaster are needed, and the technique is simple frying.

works.reason: Six rashers, two courgettes, 300g chard and four ricotta toasts make a sensible lunch for four, and the salty bacon, lemon and chilli season it well.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes of chopping and about ten to fifteen minutes at the hob is believable for a quick lunch.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Chard is the bulk of the topping, and a warm greens-on-toast lunch suits early June.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are brief, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Greens, courgettes, bacon and ricotta on toast make a balanced, appealing family lunch.
